description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Accenture Federal Services develops technology for U.S. federal government missions. The Software Developer helps build, maintain, and enhance software capabilities supporting mission operations and system management, including development, troubleshooting, integration, deployment, and documentation.
Software Developer assisting software component development, testing, and maintenance, with debugging and integration support for mission-critical workflows

Responsibilities:
• Assist in the development, testing, and maintenance of software components that support development capabilities and mission‑critical workflows
• Debug and troubleshoot software issues under the guidance of more senior engineers
• Implement enhancements, features, and bug fixes in accordance with established coding standards and configuration‑management practices
• Collaborate with systems engineers and other software developers to understand requirements, document changes, and ensure technical accuracy
• Support integration and deployment activities across development, test, and operational environments
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to process improvements and team best practices
• Maintain accurate technical documentation as part of the development lifecycle

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent relevant experience)
• Familiarity with modern programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript
• Exposure to cloud technologies, containerization, or DevSecOps concepts
• Must have an active Top Secret clearance or higher
• Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States

Preferred:
• Foundational understanding of software development principles, version control, and debugging practices
• Experience with automated testing frameworks or CI/CD pipelines
• Interest in mission-focused software development, operational systems, or systems engineering
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively
• Strong analytical skills and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and domain knowledge
